text: Python program that organizes a target directory (target dir is configurable/given)
Moves files into subdirectories named by file extension
--watch mode: keep watching and organize new files as they appear
Skip files already in subdirectories (no recursion into subdirs)
Implied: organizer.log itself must not be moved/organized
Implied: does not lose data on name collisions in destination
Implied: files without extension handled sensibly (not crash)
